name: frameforge-studio
description: Discover, understand and run ComfyUI creative workflows through a visual studio in your assistant. Connect your own local engine, inspect editable graphs, find required model downloads, and continue into images, video, speech and films.

interface.shortDescription: Your ComfyUI creative studio, inside your assistant
interface.longDescription: A native visual ComfyUI studio in your assistant: picture workflows, explained model downloads, editable connected graphs, local image/video generation, saved playback, narration, transcription and film timelines. All panel operations use MCP tools; no nested website frame or Cloud credentials. Advanced audio, video and layer controls currently use request JSON. Model weights, ComfyUI and media runtimes are separate installations. Open weights only is enforced server-side. Comfy Cloud is an external graph handoff; Civitai generation stays on its own website. Visual rendering depends on client MCP Apps support.
